chatMessage.content: How do I set up MongoDB compound indexes in Mongoose?
You can define compound indexes in Mongoose using `schema.index({ field1: 1, field2: 1 }, { unique: true });`. Make sure to call it before compiling the model.
Great, and how does that affect query performance?
Compound indexes accelerate queries matching prefix subsets of the indexed keys, ensuring fast lookups and enforcing uniqueness across both fields simultaneously.
